## General information

Quantum Metric is a digital analytics platform. It helps large companies understand how customers use their websites and apps. Its Felix Agentic product is an AI agent that investigates digital experiences by linking behavior, technical, and business data. Session Replay shows how customers move through a site. The company is based in Monument, United States. [1](https://interviewos.ai/companies/quantum-metric#src1)
